adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` explicitly returns the result of `schema.safeParse(...)` (a Zod `SafeParseReturnType` object with `{ success, data }`), not the parsed `data` itself (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `return refreshTokenResponse;`). In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh logic assigns `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and persists it via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`. That means the DB `credential.key` will be the wrapper object rather than the credential payload, which is a concrete correctness defect and will break any later code expecting `credential.key` to match `googleCredentialSchema`.
